scenario: A district court administrator is scheduling six trials—Harlow, Ibarra, Jansen, Krantz, Linden, and Moro—to be heard on six consecutive weekdays, Monday through Saturday, one trial per day. Each trial is assigned to either Judge Park or Judge Quinn. The following conditions apply: Harlow is heard earlier in the week than Jansen. Krantz is heard on some day after Moro. Ibarra is heard on Wednesday. Linden and Jansen are assigned to different judges. Whoever is heard on Monday is assigned to Judge Park. Exactly three trials are assigned to each judge. Moro and Krantz are assigned to the same judge. If Harlow is assigned to Judge Quinn, then Harlow is heard on Tuesday.
